scripts.build: npm run build --workspace retro-horror-door && npm run build --workspace retro-horror-door-sample
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace retro-horror-door && npm run lint --workspace retro-horror-door-sample
scripts.verify:lib:core: npm run lint --workspace retro-horror-door && npm run build:lib && npm run test:lib:core
scripts.verify:lib:browser: npm run verify:lib:core && npm run test:lib:browser
scripts.gallery:check: if command -v python3.12 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3.12 scripts/gallery_assets.py check; elif command -v python3.11 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3.11 scripts/gallery_assets.py check; else exec python3 scripts/gallery_assets.py check; fi
